shared_elements: animal shown in profile along a horizontal upper register
small human or humanoid figure with limbs shown schematically
elongated quadruped/reptilian creature seen from the side
linear border or framing band along an edge
low-relief carving on a large upright slab with figures set against a blank ground
justification: Both are upright slabs carved in low relief with an animal in profile occupying an upper band and a small schematic human-like figure to one side, and both use a framing linear border near the top edge. But A's content is a dense stack of registers of birds, quadrupeds and repeated motifs rendered in blocky outline, while B is dominated by two large double spirals and a crescent/disc, motifs absent from A, and B's animal is a single long serpentine beast with a rendered eye and no register system.
